title: Threads of a group
summary: The threads of a group, as the server lists them (bipe-chat/bipe#667). Opens from group-details. Groups only (ADR 0141).

sender.description: Display name of the root's sender.

preview.description: Body of the root when it is a text message. The device decrypts it. Hidden when absent.

threads.description: ThreadListService.items, in the order the service gives.

appear.effect: Room.threadListService, then ThreadListService.paginate, then read ThreadListService.items.

loadMore.effect: At the last row: paginate again, unless reachedEnd. A failed page changes nothing.

openThread.effect: Opens the thread view of spec threads for that root.

notes: The list reads a snapshot after each page. A thread that starts while the screen is open shows the next time it opens.
